subject.title: test: run Codex version contracts on dependency bumps

question: After a current-main review of the Codex/OpenAI version contract, should this protected test-routing change be merged as the canonical dependency-bump safeguard?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and validating that these are the complete owner paths requires repository and sibling Codex source inspection unavailable during this review.

options.title: Review and merge after refresh
